subject: Vendor portal invite + plan for evidence staging and key rotation
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@brightbridge.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: security@brightbridge.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Whistic/Vendr invite + initial evidence scope for SOC2 sig

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for working with BrightBridge on the security profile. We provisioned a vendor portal (Vendr) and I just sent an invite to olga_petrov@redwood.ai — you should see it from noreply@vendr.com.

To speed the review, can you: 1) confirm a single S3 staging location we can upload artifacts to, 2) provide a short SOC 2 summary (controls in-scope), and 3) confirm whether you prefer us to request service account credentials or a temporary signed URL model for automated evidence pulls?

We're aiming to have the initial evidence set uploaded by Friday. Attachment: vendor_questionnaire_v1.xlsx (placeholder).

Thanks,
Daniel Park\Senior InfoSec Program Manager\BrightBridge Health

---
Attachment: vendor_questionnaire_v1.xlsx (Excel, 48KB)

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@brightbridge.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic/Vendr invite + initial evidence scope for SOC2 sig

Hi Daniel — thanks for the invite, I accepted and can see the Vendr portal link. Quick answers inline below and a proposed plan: 

1) Staging location: we prefer an S3 prefix in our evidence bucket. I'll create a folder: s3://redwood-evidence/prod/brightbridge-20270420/ and share a manifest once it's writable.

2) SOC 2 summary: attaching a short PDF (redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf) that lists scope (CC1, CC2, CC6), audit provider, and most recent report date.

3) Evidence transfer method: we recommend temporary presigned PUT URLs for uploads from your side (no long-lived keys). If you need automated pulls, we can issue a read-only service account that is rotated every 30 days — requires approval from Security.

Proposed timeline:
- Tue (today): portal invite accepted, bucket path confirmed
- Wed: BrightBridge uploads any CSV manifests and initial evidence files
- Thu: Redwood picks up, verifies checksums, and links artifacts to Vendr profile
- Fri: final QA and answers to any follow-up SIG questions

Marcus, can you create the S3 prefix and add a simple manifest template? Neha, please advise on the rotation cadence and whether 30-day rotation is acceptable to you.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov\Vendor Programs | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (PDF, 62KB)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, Daniel Park <daniel.park@brightbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic/Vendr invite + initial evidence scope for SOC2 sig

Thanks — I created the bucket prefix and uploaded a manifest template at: https://redwood-team.s3.amazonaws.com/evidence-staging/BB-2027-0420/manifest-template.csv

S3 details (writeable presigned PUT recommended):
- Bucket: redwood-evidence
- Prefix: prod/brightbridge-20270420/
- ACL: private, server-side encryption AES256 enabled

Manifest columns: file_name, sha256, relative_path, uploaded_by, upload_timestamp

Attachment: s3-evidence-staging-manifest.csv (CSV, 2KB)

Neha — for the service account rotation plan I drafted a short doc and flagged a few questions (principally whether 30 days is too frequent for BrightBridge automation). See service-account-key-rotation-plan.md attached.

Marcus Lin\Cloud Ops | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: s3-evidence-staging-manifest.csv (CSV, 2KB); service-account-key-rotation-plan.md (Markdown, 3KB)

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@brightbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic/Vendr invite + initial evidence scope for SOC2 sig

Hi all — quick note after reviewing Marcus' plan: 30-day rotation is fine, provided BrightBridge can support automated rekeying (we will issue short-lived credentials and expect a rotation handshake). For smaller, non-automated uploads we prefer presigned PUT URLs.

A couple of security checks before we go live:
- Confirm contact for push notifications on failed uploads (we need an on-call email)
- BrightBridge needs to sign an evidence-handling appendix (I attached a one-page addendum template to the Vendr profile)

Daniel — can you confirm the on-call contact and whether you can sign the evidence-handling appendix by EOD Friday? Once confirmed, Marcus and I will finish onboarding and mark the Vendr profile as complete.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor\Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: service-account-key-rotation-plan.md (Markdown, 3KB); evidence-handling-addendum.docx (Docx, 14KB)
